original: The Bf 109 E-3 on twin floats: its gear folded away for good, it flies from the sea and the lakes. Full throttle and the stick back to lift the bow over the hump, then ease it to plane on the step; it unsticks at about 170 km/h after some 850 metres. Slower and heavier than the landplane, and it can't use a runway. No guns fitted.
